name: Recital E
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text: whereas several mayors, including DEM mayors Mehmet Sıddık Akış (Hakkâri) and Abdullah Zeydan (Van), have been arrested on the basis of vague and unsubstantiated terrorism-related allegations; whereas Ekrem İmamoğlu, Mayor of Istanbul, is facing multiple legal challenges and possible political disqualification;
